relationships.subject: JAK2 V617F
relationships.evidence_quote: Essential thrombocytosis (ET) is a myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs) primarily caused by JAK2 gene mutations.

key_findings: Case of JAK2 V617F (80%) essential thrombocytosis presenting with simultaneous STEMI and sepsis, managed with stenting, antibiotics and hydroxyurea.
